title: C: long failure while searching a big room

shows: Opens drawer after drawer (up to drawer 11+) looking for a box; goes to the dresser (the target) then back to searching, and runs out of steps.
why_interesting: Search failure: the object was on a surface that was never visited because the agent opened every container first. This is exactly what the library rule "search surfaces first, then containers" targets.
